filter_records.meaning: Keep rows whose chosen text or signed int field compares to a caller value using eq, ne, lt, le, gt or ge. Use text_field or int_field to compare two fields, passing the other zero-based index as the value. Preserve encounter order and source positions.

order_records.meaning: Stable order of complete rows by a comma-separated list of zero-based column:type:direction keys, with text or signed int and asc or desc. Use pos for original position or encounter for encounter order.

report_fields.meaning: Render the chosen comma-separated zero-based field indices or pos as a tab-separated report string per encountered row. Fields are copied verbatim without quoting.

derive_integer.meaning: Append a checked signed integer result to each row. Choose add, subtract, absolute or divide (integer truncation toward zero), and col:N or int:N as the operand. For absolute use self.
